name: applications.json
title: Job applications log
description: Every job Claude found, applied to or skipped, with status, pay, portal, notes and the exact resume sent. Updated after each application run and when status emails arrive.
schedule: Updated after each application run and every email check

name: resumes.json
title: Resumes sent
description: The exact resume content submitted with each application, one record per submitted job, parsed from the tailored LaTeX source.

name: jds.json
title: Job descriptions
description: The job description text for each application sent, saved from the posting so it stays readable after the posting closes.

name: calls.json
title: Phone screens & interviews
description: Recruiter calls and interviews found in Gmail, with dates, scheduling links and prep notes.

name: oas.json
title: Online assessments
description: Coding tests and assessments companies sent, found in Gmail, with deadlines.

name: answers.json
title: Your standard answers
description: The answers Claude uses on every application form (address and phone kept out).
schedule: Changes only when the profile changes

name: activity.json
title: Activity log
description: Everything the job hunt did: applications, skips, blocks, status changes, safety flags, scans and dashboard updates (latest 400).

name: status.json
title: Last updated
description: When the applications data last changed, and when Gmail was last checked for replies.
schedule: Applications: every 30 minutes when something changed. Email: every 6 hours.
